sn37.28:1.1: Here the text switches to an unusual voice, framing the “power” in instrumental rather than nominative as normal.
sn37.28:1.3: Again, this is unusual, as normally in such contexts a direct answer is given first, then the explanation. We would expect, “By means of the power of authority. When a lady …”. | At [an6.52:5.2](), “authority” is said to be a woman’s ultimate goal (as it is for an aristocrat).
